current_text.html: Communications from individuals shall not be received by the General Assembly, unless they originate with persons who have no other access to the Assembly. If the Assembly desires to receive and consider any such communications, other than as information, the Stated Clerk shall recommend reference to the proper Assembly committee. Letters, telegrams, emails, or telephone calls from communicants or congregations of the Presbyterian Church in America are not proper communications, and are not to be received by the Assembly.

relationships.title: Eligibility to submit overtures under RAO 11
relationships.disposition: not in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

occurrences.excerpt: A proposed amendment to RAO 11-2 and 11-10 clarifying who may submit an overture was found not in conflict with the BCO.

relationships.title: Prohibiting electronic communications regarding General Assembly voting
relationships.disposition: not in conflict but not germane to the RAO chapter proposed; Adopted

occurrences.excerpt: An overture to revise RAO 11-2 disallowing electronic communications about GA voting was found not in conflict, though not germane to the proposed RAO chapter, and adopted.
